title: Crew Mask Regulator Supply Hose — Installation

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the crew mask supply hose, including the stowage dressing that keeps the hose clear of the sliding table runner, the leak check and the mask donning check.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install the crew mask supply hose at one flight crew station and to return the crew oxygen system to service.
sections.job_setup_note: Confirm the hose part number against the aircraft standard before fitting. On aircraft with the guide bracket the sleeved section of the hose must lie on the guide and not against the sliding table runner; this dressing is what stops the abrasion returning and it is easy to get wrong when the panel is refitted in a hurry. Keep the work area free of hydrocarbons throughout.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: KEEP THE WORK AREA AND ALL TOOLS FREE OF OIL, GREASE AND SOLVENT. 2. Examine the new hose for damage and confirm the part number and the cure date on the record card. 3. Route the hose through the console, placing the sleeved section on the stowage guide where the guide bracket is fitted. 4. Remove the cap and connect the hose at the regulator manifold. Torque to the value in the fits and clearances table. 5. Remove the cap and connect the hose at the mask end. 6. CAUTION: DO NOT USE A LUBRICANT OR A THREAD SEALANT THAT IS NOT APPROVED FOR OXYGEN SERVICE. 7. Open the crew oxygen supply valve slowly and let the line pressurise. 8. Do a leak check at both connections with the approved leak detection fluid, then remove all traces of the fluid. 9. Confirm the system pressure is stable for five minutes. 10. Do the mask donning check and confirm the mask can be taken from the stowage and donned with one hand in less than five seconds. 11. Refit the console side panel and repeat the donning check with the panel in position.
sections.close_out: Remove the warning notices and tell the flight crew that the crew oxygen system is serviceable. Record the installation, the hose part number, the cure date and the donning check result in the aircraft technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; step 3 guide dressing applies to aircraft post MOD-168062

safety_precautions: Keep the work area free of hydrocarbons.
Open the supply valve slowly to avoid an adiabatic temperature rise at the fitting.
